text:
Hey! Staging should be able to go out today. We're just waiting on QA sign-off, which they expect to finish by 3 pm.

All 212 tests passed. One of them was flaky and only went green after two retries. That doesn't block the deploy, but I'll open a ticket so we can find the cause before it bites us later.

The deploy window closes at 5 pm. If QA signs off at 3, that leaves about two hours to deploy, run smoke checks, and roll back if something looks off. That's comfortable, though a delay would eat into it quickly.

I'll have everything staged so we can go as soon as QA gives the thumbs up. If sign-off runs past about 4 pm, I'd push to tomorrow morning so we aren't deploying right before the window closes.

I'll post here once I hear from QA. Shout if you need it sooner or have any concerns!
